$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase), which players see as
his Boss Kill Claim, pays for the first win on the normal ride each day. Every roll is read on its
own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays and the Hoard is never empty; the next is the
chance at a Grave Candle, which gives back what opening the graveyard costs; the four after it are
the chances at the plain pieces of his armour (the Horseman's Breastplate, Gauntlets, Greaves and
Helm, members of the Hallowed set); the two after those are the chances at the Flaming Hallowed
set's Jack pieces, the Burning Jack Helm and the Flaming Jack Shield, which Old Jack's shop also
trades for a plain Jack Helm or Jack Shield;
then the Horseman's Steed Trophy, a tiny figure of his horse to place as a
block, on every server; then two pieces of his graveyard to build with, a tombstone and a ruins
lantern like the ones that stand in it, which no recipe makes and which pay from this Hoard alone;
the last always pays Old Jack's Favor, so the normal ride is a way toward the Regular rank that
opens the hard ride. The hard ride's Hoard (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json) pays more Grave
Candles, his armour, the two Jack pieces and the trophy at better odds, his flaming armour (the
breastplate, gauntlets, greaves and helm, which never pay here) and the Eternal Candle, and the
Hallowed's favor instead of Old Jack's; Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json
adds Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs, and Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins_Chase.json the Horseman's
Reins where Alec's Tamework runs. The Hoard is not scaled by each player's share of the fight,
so everyone who fought him rolls these odds. The Almanac's Hoard grid
(ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve.json) lists what this table and the hard one
pay, so change them together. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. HideInPreview on the two
Flaming pieces and the trophy keeps them out of any list of what this table pays (a reward paying it lists its
contents on hover); the Hoard itself lands as a Claim of what it rolled, and the rolls pay the same
either way.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase
